title: A change to a kbcommon.SECRETS shape reads the verdicts the old shape cached: the publish scan's cache key holds SCAN_FORM, which no one bumps
goal: kbpublic.scan_form, the leak scan's cache key, holds a digest of kbcommon.SECRETS beside SCAN_FORM and the registry's private patterns, so a change to a secret shape (BG-3vnu37rq narrowed the armor line to one with key material after it) reads no verdict cached under the old shape, and the repro exits 0

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import hashlib, kbcommon, kbpublic; sys.exit(0 if hashlib.sha256(kbcommon.secrets_rx().encode()).hexdigest()[:12] in kbpublic.scan_form() else 1)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbcommon,kbpublic;a=kbpublic.scan_form();kbcommon.SECRETS=list(kbcommon.SECRETS)+['zzplantedshape[0-9]{9}'];b=kbpublic.scan_form();print('fresh key after a SECRETS change:',a!=b);sys.exit(0 if a!=b else 1)

clauses.clause: kbpublic.scan_form, the leak scan's cache key, holds a digest of kbcommon.SECRETS beside SCAN_FORM and the registry's private patterns, so a change to a secret shape (BG-3vnu37rq narrowed the armor line to one with key material after it) reads no verdict cached under the old shape

notes: Premise 2026-10-23 on 35b5b7cb2: the repro exits 1 (scan_form holds no SECRETS digest); a planted SECRETS shape leaves scan_form unchanged.
